renderer_findings.scope: Current reviewed page renderer and synthetic text only. Generated HTML strings inspected, no browser execution or network.

improvements: The native model identifies every parsed snapshot value using the documented typed JSON/binary64 SHA-256 contract. The browser must match all fields and the publication identity before showing risk alongside separately acquired holdings. Equivalent object order and numeric spelling match; altered holdings, unknown added fields, array order, type changes or missing bindings do not.

Private snapshot acquisition reads through EOF within four MiB, checks typed SDK length when provided, closes every body, and rejects duplicate JSON keys, malformed Unicode and unsafe/nonfinite values before provider work.

Browser inputs use the existing strict complete scenario I/O primitives, a four MiB limit and twelve-second header/body deadline. Generation guards and cancellation stop delayed prior responses from overwriting newer successful or failed loads. Local sixty-second age checks make no requests; the five-minute network cadence remains unchanged.
Risk with an unverified snapshot stays withheld even if its timestamp later enters the display window. Missing/stale/error states clear earlier values and preserve missing-versus-zero distinctions.

Typed numeric rendering, escaped source text, whitelisted tier classes and ordinary encoded ticker links replace unsafe raw HTML and inline JavaScript. Alert thresholds require measured values; malformed flags cannot manufacture a VaR breach.

browser_acceptance.scope: Original page and current reviewed scripts; complete outputs from the current pure native model with wholly synthetic holdings. External connections denied by CSP, no authentication bootstrap or actual account data.
browser_acceptance.matching: AAA complete source snapshot matches native binding; holdings VaR 9.31 USD, 6.36% volatility per gross, beta per gross 1.00; account NAV metrics unavailable.
browser_acceptance.mismatch: Changing quantity 10 to 11 keeps separately received holdings visible but clears risk and reports a snapshot mismatch.
browser_acceptance.duplicate: Duplicate NAV field visibly fails strict decoding and clears prior timestamp and values.
browser_acceptance.race: Delayed older AAA response is released after newer BBB; BBB and measured zero VaR/volatility/beta remain displayed.
browser_acceptance.keyboard: Return activates the response-race control and focuses the AAA ticker link; link has a fixed same-site stock path, noopener/noreferrer and no inline handler. Preview navigation is intentionally denied.

limitations: Exact native and static deployment remain pending. All six predecessor package members, 1024 MiB/300-second resources and both existing hourly :43 bindings were independently recorded by receipt-only operation 6352.
Normal private publication is unverified and no actual account is inspected. Legacy outputs without a complete binding are withheld until normal publication supplies one.

A semantic value identity is not an HTTP byte identity, authenticated signature, provider validation, account reconciliation or prediction qualification. Four MiB input limits reject oversize documents rather than truncating them.

Both original hourly schedule bindings are retained. This change does not repair scheduling duplication, publication ordering or qualification of the native risk assumptions. All ten platform workstreams remain open.
